question: Jog Falls is the most thrilling spectacle in the entire western region of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Jog Falls is a popular tourist destination in **Karnataka.**__
 
• It is situated in Karnataka's **Shimoga district.**
 
• Gerusoppe Falls, Gersoppa Falls, and Jogada Gundi are some of the other names for Jog Falls.
 
• Jog Falls is one of India's tallest waterfalls.
 
• It is India's highest untiered waterfall, as it falls directly from the cliffs without tumbling down.
 
• The** Sharavati,** which drops 253 metres, creates Jog Falls (830 ft).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43140efd950153ba96f5946d458dd7a67445cdac1aaa17715efca223b3f515ce.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Waterfalls in **Karnataka**:

 
 
• Gaganachukki and Bharachukki Falls.
 
• Dabbe Falls.
 
• Barkana Falls.
 
• Kunchikal Falls.
 
• Apsarakonda Falls.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Phek Waterfall is a waterfall located in **Nagaland.**
 
• Nuranang Waterfall is a waterfall located in **Arunachal Pradesh.**
 
• Wimberley Gunj Waterfalls is a waterfall located in **Andaman and Nicobar.**
